protocol: This is a small, frozen transfer evaluation. It compares an original paper-style prompt/scaffold with EvalRX-generated L1/L2 candidates on the same target model; it is not a claim of exact reproduction of the paper's reported scale or model.

papers.title: Large Language Models are Zero-Shot Reasoners
papers.method_family: L1 prompt: append a chain-of-thought instruction

papers.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
papers.method_family: L2 scaffold: sample diverse reasoning paths and aggregate answers

papers.title: Least-to-Most Prompting Enables Complex Reasoning in Large Language Models
papers.method_family: L2 scaffold: decompose a problem, then solve using the subproblems

papers.title: Self-Refine: Iterative Refinement with Self-Feedback
papers.method_family: L2 scaffold: draft, self-feedback, and revision

papers.title: Chain-of-Verification Reduces Hallucination in Large Language Models
papers.method_family: L2 scaffold: draft, independent verification questions, final response
papers.evaluation_note: The public TruthfulQA multiple-choice slice is a transfer evaluation for this hallucination-reduction method, not the paper's original long-form generation protocol.
